B_CELL_PLASMA.description: B cell / plasma cell signature derived from Bindea 2013. Contains B-cell markers (CD19, MS4A1/CD20, CR2/CD21, BLNK, TCL1A) and plasma-cell / immunoglobulin markers (IGHA1, IGHG1, IGHM, IGKC, IGL@, TNFRSF17/BCMA).
B_CELL_PLASMA.msigdb_status: deprecated (no longer present in MSigDB v2022.1.Hs, v2023.1.Hs, v2024.1.Hs)
B_CELL_PLASMA.fallback_source: Bindea 2013 Supplementary Table 1, mirrored as bindea_immune.txt in Sage-Bionetworks/crc-cms-kras (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sage-Bionetworks/crc-cms-kras/master/bindea_immune.txt)
B_CELL_PLASMA.notes: MSigDB BINDEA_PLASMA_CELLS is deprecated. The Bindea 2013 paper does not have a separate Plasma cells category; the canonical Bindea 'B cells' signature (used here) already includes the plasma-cell-defining immunoglobulin genes. Gene symbols are kept as-is from the source mirror; legacy aliases present: KIAA0125 (= FAM30A), IGL@ (immunoglobulin lambda locus, no single HGNC symbol).

CYTOLYTIC_ACTIVITY.description: Canonical 2-gene cytolytic activity (CYT) score (geometric mean of GZMA and PRF1)
CYTOLYTIC_ACTIVITY.notes: Original Rooney 2015 definition is the 2-gene geometric mean of GZMA and PRF1. A richer 8-gene effector / cytotoxic-core alternative is sometimes used: GZMA, GZMB, GZMH, GZMK, PRF1, GNLY, NKG7, IFNG. We use the canonical 2-gene version here.
